question: With identical observed inputs and starting capital, does the frozen participation policy improve net portfolio equity over the repaired original V5 pipeline; does a 24h research reference add value to the same 24h holding candidate?

cohorts.A_original_v5: Repaired original V5 pipeline, frozen static factors, independent account and risk state; new entries at common cutoff; full live event executor is not reproduced
cohorts.B_participation_v1: Existing participation direction/ranking kernel and 72h maximum hold
cohorts.C_hold24_only: B with maximum_holding_hours changed to 24 only
cohorts.D_reference_only: C plus an admissible frozen-version 24h DEFER at the same common quote decision; no REVIEW_ENTRY signal creation

fee_currency_policy: observed instrument contract; no unsupported fee-token conversion
fill_rule: strictly subsequent observed ask/bid, validated quantity lot/minimum and fee currency
forward_start: first natural observation in new ledger after verified v2 release; first shared entry decision at hour+360s, deadline hour+480s
weight_comparison: Static and admitted dynamic evidence are separate experiments; missing valid historical weight reports yields insufficient evidence, never permission to enable dynamic production weights
reference_compatibility: All six semantic bindings must match exactly. New advice/input/publication identities and display-only metadata may refresh; changed worker code requires a new cohort. Newest first-received advice per symbol wins, including unknown versions (recorded, never applied).
valuation_contract: Economic equity retains all assets net of modeled exit costs. Executable liquidation and restricted residual quantity/value/cost are separate. Entry floor is not an exchange specification.
